fraudIqPage.scenarioTitle: Real-time card fraud — from 90 minutes to 30 seconds

fraudIqPage.advisoryNote: Advisory · human approval required before action.
fraudIqPage.microsoftIqIntro: Anti-fraud intelligence powered by Microsoft IQ: Fabric IQ (data & ontology, live on our tables), Work IQ (Microsoft 365 work context) and Foundry IQ (agent knowledge & reasoning).

fabric.description: The semantic layer over OneLake — ontology, business concepts and relationships — that lets agents reason over governed enterprise data, not raw tables.

work.description: The intelligence layer over work in Microsoft 365 — people, documents, meetings and communications — giving agents organizational context.

foundry.description: Unified knowledge, retrieval and memory for agents in Microsoft Foundry — grounding reasoning in policies, regulations and tool outputs.

web.description: Real-time web grounding via Microsoft Web IQ — restricted to official regulatory domains, returning cited obligations with source links.

knowledge.tagline: From enterprise knowledge to the live web, via semantic search
knowledge.description: One unified knowledge layer: semantic search across enterprise policies, regulations and tool outputs in Microsoft Foundry, extended in real time to the web via Microsoft Web IQ — restricted to official regulatory domains, with cited obligations and links to their sources.

settings.title: Settings & Governance
settings.subtitle: Role-based access, PII masking, environment and the audit trail.

general.title: General & telemetry
general.desc: Advanced, browser-local options. Values are stored only in this browser.
general.appInsightsNote: When set, diagnostic traces are forwarded to Application Insights. Stored only in this browser; reload to fully apply a change.
general.timeoutNote: Max wait for the live Foundry agent before falling back to the demo answer (1000–120000 ms, default 5000).
general.backendNote: A reachable backend is required for the live Work IQ, Teams and RAFT pillars. Overrides the build-time VITE_BACKEND_API_URL for this browser — no rebuild needed.

settings.piiNote: PII (name, IBAN) is masked for roles without view permission (e.g. Auditor). AI recommendations are always non-binding and require human approval.
settings.envNote: When a Fabric Data Agent is configured (FABRIC_APP_MODE=fabric), agents ground on live Fabric data over REST; otherwise deterministic demo responses are used.

foundry.title: Foundry Agent Service
foundry.desc: Choose the orchestrator agent to run for the wired Foundry project. The selection is stored only in this browser and sent to the backend on each run, overriding the deployed default.
foundry.overrideNote: Overriding the deployed FOUNDRY_ORCHESTRATOR_AGENT for this browser.
foundry.connectionNote: Tenant, client and endpoint are stored only in this browser; used to sign in and call your Foundry IQ agent directly.

webiq.title: Microsoft Web IQ
webiq.desc: Ground regulatory citations on official sources. Enter your Web IQ API key to enable the live pillar. The key is stored only in this browser and sent to the backend proxy on each request — it is never bundled or committed.
webiq.placeholder: Paste your Web IQ API key
webiq.needsBackend: A reachable backend (live mode) is required for the live regulatory search.

modelQuality.advisory: Fine-tuning does not remove human approval; every run is still advisory and audited.
